newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - June state CPI from Monday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - June state CPI from Monday.

text.p: German regional consumer price data for June will be released from today, Monday, with the state of Bavaria expecting to release its data in the afternoon.
The states of North Rhine-Westphalia, Baden-Wuerttemberg and Hesse expect to release their price data on Wednesday, the states' respective statistics offices said on Monday.
North Rhine-Westphalia's statistics office said there was a chance it will release its data on Tuesday.
The regional data are used to calculate preliminary west German data which the Federal Statistics Office expects to release on Wednesday.
In May, the west Gernman consumer price index rose 0.4 percent month-on-month and 1.5 percent year-on-year.
The pan-German consumer price index rose 0.4 percent month-on-month and 1.6 percent year-on-year.
